How this model was evaluated

The scikit-learn Iris dataset contains 150 labelled flowers with four measurements. This model uses a stratified 80/20 train/test split with seed 42. StandardScaler is fitted on the training set only, followed by logistic regression. The test set contains 30 samples.

Evaluation loading… One small holdout split is not evidence of production accuracy. This is an educational benchmark, not an image-recognition or real-world botanical identification service.
